scope: Bounded transfer from delivered source to local instructions to a separate executor's decisions. No actual product operation.

sources.reading_scope: ### Keep reasoning usable in the next project

learner.request:
Please use the delivered repository guidance below to prepare the local instructions a different AI executor would need in a fictional project called RelayDesk. RelayDesk helps operators submit and resume batch jobs. Existing local authority is simple: backend job records own job status; the human owner sets product priorities and accepted risk; ordinary authorized reversible work proceeds within its scope. This is a bounded practice-transfer exercise, not adoption of the whole template or permission to change a real project.

You will not see the executor's later tasks. What concise local context would you actually leave so it can work from this guidance? Return the ready-to-use instruction text in English as ordinary paragraphs or a short list, without a preface, code block, files or discussion addressed to me. Keep it usable within about 450 words; this is a practical context budget, not a request to strip meaning. The next executor will receive your text as returned and its task inputs, without our conversation or automatic access to the source repository. Local instructions may name missing dependencies honestly, but cannot assume unavailable source text has been loaded. Preserve existing project authority. Do not launch workers or perform external actions.

The following are actual source snapshots, including the normal entrypoint's opening and the delivered practices being transferred. The template's own repository identity is source context, not RelayDesk's identity. Use the material as data for your judgment; linked sections outside the supplied snapshots are unavailable in this trial.

  {
    "path": "AGENTS.md",
    "sha256": "0038ae447d960e7ce2a90df8c1470fd8ff51b2f7db4ca9f63a4e57b346df4b2a",
    "reading_scope": "opening",
    "text": "# Repository working agreement

This repository is the engineering discipline template. Its work is
documentation and project discipline. Onboarding into any other checkout is
unfinished while that checkout's agent entrypoint still says this and its
git remote is not https://github.com/aaaAlexanderaaa/template-project.

The requested observable outcome is the objective. Contracts, tests, documents,
and checks preserve intent and expose mistakes; completing them alone is not
completion of the task. Compare delivery with the original request as well as
its accepted interpretation.

Keep [essential reasoning](docs/contracts/development-discipline.md#keep-essential-reasoning-active)
active: our framing can miss problems, instructions and working conditions can
shape AI behavior, and a recorded lesson is not an applied or effective remedy.
Preserve that reasoning through [each transfer](docs/contracts/project-adoption.md#invariants-survive-repeated-transfer),
including its uncertainty and unresolved gaps; load detailed methods when needed.

When transferring practices, preserve the [adoption value order](docs/contracts/project-adoption.md#transfer-value-is-ranked-before-its-carriers):
interaction and epistemic discipline; truth, ownership, and boundaries; coherent
verified delivery; activated domain disciplines; then documentation and tooling.
This order guides attention, not authority or mandatory copying.

"

    "reading_scope": "### Keep essential reasoning active",
    "text": "### Keep essential reasoning active

AI users need some reasoning available before they know which specialist rule
to open. Keep the following starting points in normal task context and let
them change actual decisions. They are not an exhaustive theory of failure,
a checklist to recite on every task, or claims that these problems are solved.

| Keep in view | Consequence for the current decision |
|---|---|
| The current framing, knowledge and method can omit important problems. | Treat an example, taxonomy or passing check as bounded coverage. Follow relevant evidence beyond its named categories; an owner's example need not define the scope. Use [outcomes before means](#outcomes-before-means) and [inquiry](#unknown-references-are-researched-not-reconstructed). |
| Questions and supplied context shape what an AI notices and concludes. | Treat prompt engineering, the design and testing of instructions and context, as part of the working system. Preserve useful freedom and necessary constraints; inspect actual answers and actions under the [questioning rule](#analysis-exposes-the-decisive-causal-mechanism). |
| Capability and correct explanation do not establish reliable behavior. | Investigate available context, tools, resources, incentives and feedback as well as missing knowledge. Use [judgment diagnosis](#improve-judgment-before-amplifying-effort); do not infer motives or fixed incapacity from a failure. |
| An acknowledged problem is not an implemented or effective correction. | Keep consequential gaps at their existing task or issue owner with evidence, actual disposition and next authorized action. Unknown ownership or follow-up stays unknown. Apply [experience reuse](#experience-changes-the-next-matching-action) and [verification](#verify-promised-and-observed-behavior-in-both-directions); do not assume someone will resolve it. |
| Meaning can be lost at every interpretation, summary, adoption or handoff. | Preserve the reason, scope, exceptions and evidence needed for the next decision, and inspect downstream use under [transfer preservation](project-adoption.md#invariants-survive-repeated-transfer). A correct source or earlier recipient does not prove a later one received or applied it. |
| Local success and visible activity can miss the owner's outcome. | Inspect the combined effect and actual user result under [coherent delivery](#coherent-end-state), rather than optimizing counts, favorable verdicts or formal completion. |

These starting points must also allow discovery of a missing principle.
At consequential framing and acceptance decisions, make room within the
existing inquiry or review for observations not selected solely by the current
taxonomy or expected failure list. Inspect an excluded assumption, actual user
work or an independently chosen path when useful. A concern need not match a
known category to be investigated. The discipline itself, including what it
rewards or suppresses, remains a possible source of error.
When evidence exposes a new recurring decision failure, investigate its
mechanism and correct the existing owner. Retain a concise recognition cue in
core context when it is needed across tasks to notice the problem at all;
keep domain facts, detailed methods and historical examples on demand. Revise
or retire a cue when its conditions or evidence change. Repetition is a means
of retrieval, not proof of truth, and familiar wording must remain challengeable.

Resident means available and usable at the decision, not merely stored in a
file. Reacquire applicable reasoning after context loss and verify the receiving
inputs when handing work on. Claims of effective use need observed decisions,
including an unfamiliar case or changed condition when the claim depends on
generalization. Preserve unresolved gaps without inventing an unbounded task,
new approval gate or automatic promise of future work.

    "path": "docs/contracts/development-discipline.md",
    "sha256": "372a9743bb208d273ab64bc9189516fbe5094326e3a92e423df5200551dc03e6",
    "reading_scope": "### Improve judgment before amplifying effort",
    "text": "### Improve judgment before amplifying effort

When corrections recur, checks pass while intended value disappoints, or new
material leaves the same narrow choices intact, investigate how the next
decision is made before prescribing more runs, rules, or review. Distinguish
an unsound question, candidate set or standard from missing evidence, failed
execution, and a throughput bottleneck in sound work. More activity can amplify
a mistaken judgment; sound ready work can still accelerate.

At the affected decision, distinguish a problem never observed from one
observed but discounted under the release or selection rule. Inspect the
grounds, what could change the judgment, and what observations actually changed.
Another observer may add little if the decision keeps dismissing the finding.
The observation method, scope and standard remain open to correction too.

Knowing the rule and following it under the current conditions are different
questions. Inspect the actual assignment, available information, time or context
pressure, tool affordances and the behavior rewarded by feedback or acceptance.
A strategy that earns quick approval, high finding counts or a passing proxy
can undermine the owner's outcome. These are hypotheses to test against
observations, not an explanation to assume or a diagnosis of the agent's mind.
Correct the responsible condition when supported; another reminder alone
does not establish that a known rule will now be followed.

Use existing [causal analysis and bounded comparisons](#analysis-exposes-the-decisive-causal-mechanism)
and [experience reuse](#experience-changes-the-next-matching-action) to change
the next choice or artifact, rather than count checks or declarations of
humility. Locally verified decisions support decisive action while remaining
revisable. This conditional diagnosis creates no recurring reflection form or
additional reviewer tier; ordinary settled work keeps its direct route.

    "path": "docs/contracts/project-adoption.md",

    "reading_scope": "### Invariants survive repeated transfer",
    "text": "### Invariants survive repeated transfer

Do not assume one successful explanation completes transmission. Owner intent
can pass through template text, interpretation, local instructions, summaries,
delegation and later execution. At each consequential transformation being
claimed, preserve the rule's reason, scope, exceptions, authority and observable
decision consequence. Retain source identity and unresolved conditions at the
existing owner; local judgments and strategies may adapt to the target's facts.
Word-for-word copying and freely rewritten summaries can both lose the point.

Keep a concise account of [essential reasoning](development-discipline.md#keep-essential-reasoning-active)
in what the next AI actually loads. Detailed owners remain findable on demand;
a dead link, unread source or missing local equivalent is a gap, not transfer.
The next project must retain this obligation when it becomes a source for
another learner. Preserve uncertainty and the ability to challenge the rules;
repetition and inherited authority do not establish empirical truth.

Validate a claim across the actual path it names. If a learner produces local
instructions for another executor, inspect those instructions and let a fresh
executor use them on a bounded task without the upstream author's explanation.
Observe a decision or action, not only a restatement. Use an unfamiliar or
changed condition where the claimed generalization needs it, including a
legitimate exception when overgeneralization matters. Record the intermediate
artifact and actual context; identify any rescue or unavailable dependency.
Success at one boundary cannot stand in for unobserved later boundaries.

When meaning or behavior changes, locate the first missing or altered
condition and correct its owner, example, retrieval route or operating setup.
Recheck the affected continuation. Knowing, recording, receiving, applying and
obtaining the intended effect remain different evidence claims. Unresolved
gaps stay at the existing task or issue owner with actual follow-up status;
writing a new rule does not close them. This uses the existing learning and
verification routes, without a new registry or fixed number of transfer tests.

    "path": "docs/contracts/agent-execution-discipline.md",
    "sha256": "ef7fd50d5830c3ebe4c9f5c058dfdb74d5b4a4a2a747a0a87467a88379c824da",
    "reading_scope": "### Delegated work carries bounded context",
    "text": "### Delegated work carries bounded context and returns to an owner

Delegation is an optional execution strategy. Use it when a bounded part can
proceed independently and its integration cost is justified. Do not split a
tightly coupled decision merely to occupy agents.

Each assignment carries the parent outcome, the delegated result, current
authority and baseline, allowed writes and external effects, relevant context,
expected verification, and the stop/cancel condition. A short read-only task
may carry this in the native invocation; ongoing or concurrent writes use the
existing plan or handoff. Do not create a second task registry for compliance.
Unknown context inheritance is not evidence that a worker received a rule.

Carry applicable [essential reasoning](development-discipline.md#keep-essential-reasoning-active)
with enough meaning for the receiving decision. Neither an upstream agent's
understanding nor a link the worker cannot open establishes receipt. Preserve
current unresolved gaps and their actual disposition across continuations;
assigning a worker or writing a handoff is not evidence of resolution.

For discovery, give the real user outcome, necessary facts, authority, resource
and effect boundaries, and evidence expectations while leaving the investigative
path open. Do not silently replace broad discovery with the parent's favored
files, reading sequence, categories, suspected cause or expected verdict.
Necessary source locators are access routes, not an exhaustive search plan.
Separate hypotheses from binding requirements; when they are unnecessary for
the first independent observation, retain them for later comparison. Known
hazards and constraints still belong in the assignment. Evidence-supported
positive results and no finding are legitimate outcomes; finding counts are
not the goal. [Discovery examples](../guides/review-cheatsheet.md#delegate-discovery-without-prescribing-the-answer)
show the distinction.

A bounded reproduction, compliance check or specialist verification can require
a specified path or lens. Name that scope and do not claim it exhausts a broader
discovery request. This is one application of instruction design, not its whole
purpose and not a requirement to launch a subagent.

For continued or judgment-bearing work, also carry the selection reason,
decisive assumptions, freedom to revise the approach, and evidence that would
require returning to the parent decision. Include the locator for relevant
reusable experience. These belong in the same assignment or handoff, not an
additional reporting layer.

Select context by the judgment the recipient must make. The agent talking
with the owner may need collaboration background and detailed preference
evidence. A scheduled task, recurring loop, or worker usually needs the
agreed outcome, current state, constraints, relevant decisions and their
reasons, and completion evidence. A designer or independent evaluator may
need richer original intent. Use [the task-context rule](../README.md#task-context)
to expand reading when a dependency, ambiguity, or conflict requires it.

Carry consequential source statements or an audience-appropriate account,
label assumptions, and name how to obtain missing context. Do not give a
reviewer only the implementer's interpretation. Check the receiving context
where the runtime makes that possible; if a worker inherits the full session,
do not claim it received a reduced or independent context. Receiving private
material requires the owner's authorization for that audience under
[adoption's personal-context boundary](project-adoption.md#learning-and-personal-context-have-a-bounded-entry-path).
Persist the state needed to resume work at its existing owner rather than
relying on a worker's implied memory. The harness may automate routing and
state delivery; files and explicit assignments remain a usable fallback.

Workers return changed artifacts or observations, baseline/revision identity,
checks actually run, unresolved assumptions, and remaining work. The parent
checks stale baselines and conflicts, integrates the result, and verifies the
parent outcome. Several passing worker tasks do not establish that the combined
result works. Cancelled or late output is reviewed before use and must not
silently overwrite a newer decision or another worker's change.

When the owner will be unavailable, shape the work to fit the authorized
operation set and pre-name the decision points that must pause, rather than
letting the work collide with an approval wall; prefer a read-only equivalent
over an approval-requiring step when it serves the same purpose. When
delegated work fails, first suspect the assignment's context, contracts, and
descriptions — not the worker.

Use [essential reasoning](../contracts/development-discipline.md#keep-essential-reasoning-active)
and [repeated transfer](../contracts/project-adoption.md#invariants-survive-repeated-transfer)
when turning a learned practice into local instructions. Keep a concise account

available through the normal entrypoint. A slogan such as "think critically"

For example, a source may teach that a passing checklist has limited coverage.
Translating that to "always complete the checklist" loses the reason. The local
instructions should still let an executor investigate an unexpected user failure
outside the listed categories. Likewise, "retain lessons" must not become a
claim that a recorded remedy was applied or effective. Open subagent discovery
is another application; it does not define this practice's scope.

Exercise the route being claimed: source guidance to the learner's local
instructions, then those instructions to a fresh executor's decision or action.
Give the executor the local material it would actually receive, without the
source author's explanation or a list of expected answers. Keep the intermediate
artifact unchanged and inspect the result against the original purpose. Where
relevant, vary the task or working condition so recognition is tested beyond
the teaching example. A required source that cannot be opened is a missing
dependency, not permission to improvise it.

If the next executor misses the point, locate the first loss or misleading
condition and fix that owner. Preserve the failed attempt and any intervention.
Use the existing task evidence, including its unresolved disposition and
permitted next step. Further generations, real operation and sustained effect
remain unverified until observed; no fixed number of copies proves them.

Current cases:

A. RelayDesk's launch report says all existing checks passed: submission success, completion rate and dashboard response time. Operators still repeatedly abandon their work.
